answer: The portcullis is Starchartmaker atlas assay attested before the celestial record. It drops on 4-year night-watch service, 152 supervised sightings, field exam, annual record dues, and it drops separately for every key. One proof costs 92 POA; 654 proofs cost 60168 POA, and the farm must pay before it earns anything. Follow the basalt back to the office that issued it, follow the mesa back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the marble back to the year it was filed. The honest path is short; the farm's path is long, expensive, and watched.
